I will do this bean plot almost the same way I did before, because cash is tight and I cannot risk buying many inputs. I own this land, so I will carry manure from home and put it there, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer for this plot. I will keep my local seed, and I will spray a little for insects because if I leave cowpea like that, I can lose plenty. I will wait for rain only, and most of the work I will do with my family, but I will bring a few people for the heavy work.
